summary: Load-harness generator health: client/server error taxonomy + connection bounding
description: From TKT-82 ai-review pass 3 (incidental): the on-sale load harness (smoke/internal/loadtest) classifies all attempt errors identically, so client-side transport/resource exhaustion is indistinguishable from server instability in the ceiling bracket; the shared HTTP transport also has unbounded active connections at high sweep rates (cap rate*4 permits 12k concurrent at 3,000/s). Harden before TKT-31/TKT-37 reuse the harness: (1) classify transport-level errors (err != nil) separately from HTTP-status errors and treat client-side classes as inconclusive, not unstable; (2) bound and report client connections/goroutines; (3) unit tests for late-scheduling-without-drops and drops-with-client-errors. The lag-p99 schedule guard and the cap-drops-with-SLO-met inconclusive rule shipped in TKT-82.
